title: Work IQ: business skills for agents through Work IQ MCP
summary: The EU/EFTA opt-in instruction leaves out a required environment setting: Microsoft says to enable both the tenant and environment settings, not just the Microsoft 365 setting. The roadmap facts and the listed governance controls, including the Allowed MCP Clients API, are supported.

claims.claim: Business skills are natural-language process instructions covering steps, required information and business rules.
claims.quote: Each skill describes how to complete a specific type of work—the steps involved, the information required, and the business rules that apply.

claims.claim: Business skills are stored in Dataverse.
claims.quote: Business skills are stored in Dataverse and follow Dataverse security patterns.

claims.claim: Agents discover and use accessible skills at runtime through Work IQ MCP.
claims.quote: Agents discover and use the business skills they have access to as needed at runtime using Work IQ MCP to complete tasks according to your organization's processes.

claims.claim: Multiple agents using the same skill follow the same process.
claims.quote: When multiple agents use the same skill, they follow the same process, ensuring consistent behavior across your organization.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters; Scope
claims.claim: Work IQ is on by default for eligible new public production environments in new or existing tenants.
claims.quote: Business Applications in Work IQ is on by default for new public production environments created for new or existing tenants.
claims.fix: Keep the qualified on-by-default statement, but add: 'The general feature-settings reference still lists the Dataverse intelligence (Work IQ) setting's default as Off; the dedicated default-settings page describes the new-environment default above.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/settings-features#dataverse-intelligence-preview.

claims.claim: Automatic enablement for eligible existing environments has been deferred from the previously documented November 2026 schedule.
claims.quote: The plan to turn on Business Applications in Work IQ for existing environments that aren't listed as exceptionshas been deferred from the previously documented November 2026 schedule.

claims.claim: The current default-settings page gives no replacement date for existing-environment automatic enablement.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ environment enable setting API PowerShell organization table WorkIQ; Work IQ EU default. Read the full Business Applications in Work IQ default-settings page; it says the November 2026 schedule is deferred and to check for updates, without a replacement date.

claims.claim: EU and EFTA environments are exceptions to default enablement.
claims.quote: European Union (EU) and European Free Trade Association (EFTA) environments: This exception applies to environments provisioned in the EU and EFTA macro region geography.

claims.claim: Government-related environments are exceptions to default enablement.
claims.quote: Government-related environments: This exception applies to environments provisioned by customers with current or previous government cloud deployments that are likely to depend on FedRAMP security controls.

claims.claim: Trial, sandbox and developer environments are exceptions to default enablement.
claims.quote: Nonproduction environments: This exception applies to trial, sandbox, and developer environments.

claims.claim: Customers can turn on Work IQ for EU/EFTA environments during public preview with the corresponding Microsoft 365 admin center setting.
claims.quote: If Business Applications in Work IQ isn't on by default in your environment, you can turn it on. Turn on the tenant-level setting in the Microsoft 365 admin center and the environment-level setting in the Power Platform admin center.
claims.fix: Replace the EU/EFTA parenthesis with: '(customers can turn on Work IQ by enabling both the tenant-level setting in the Microsoft 365 admin center and the environment-level setting in the Power Platform admin center)'. The current source requires both settings and no longer phrases this as an EU/EFTA public-preview-specific route.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Scope
claims.claim: A Power Platform administrator can manually enable Work IQ for the environment.
claims.quote: To enable business skills in a Dataverse environment, a Power Platform administrator turns on Work IQ.

claims.claim: Business skills require a Dataverse environment with Work IQ enabled.
claims.quote: A Dataverse environment with Work IQ enabled by a Power Platform administrator.

claims.claim: Skill selection is probabilistic.
claims.quote: Agent selection is probabilistic, so test representative requests before you share a skill broadly.

claims.claim: Sharing settings govern who can read skills and their resources.
claims.quote: General access—Makes the skill available to everyone in the environment. ... Direct access—Shares the skill with specific users or groups and lets you choose whether they can view or edit the skill.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Ownership, sharing and Dataverse security roles govern skill creation, modification and use.
claims.quote: Governance—Control who can create, modify, and use business skills through ownership, sharing, and Dataverse security roles.

claims.claim: Security-role sharing requires both the selected Dataverse role and Skill Sharing Role.
claims.quote: Users who access a skill through a Dataverse security role must have both the selected role and the Skill Sharing Role security role.

claims.claim: General access and direct sharing are distinct from security-role sharing.
claims.quote: You can provide access to a business skill in three ways: ... General access ... Security role access ... Direct access

claims.claim: Activating an updated skill makes the changed instructions available to agents.
claims.quote: Save and activate | Makes your changes the active version, including its associated resources.

claims.claim: Saving a working copy alone does not change the active version agents use.
claims.quote: Save | Saves your working copy without changing the version agents use. A new skill remains inactive. If the skill already has an active version, that version stays active.

claims.claim: Environment Work IQ participation is controlled in Power Platform admin center through Manage > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Work IQ.
claims.quote: Select Manage, and select the environment. ... Select Settings > Product > Features. ... Locate Work IQ. ... Turn on Work IQ if it's currently off.

claims.claim: No API equivalent for the environment Work IQ setting is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ Set-TenantSettings Power Platform; Work IQ Power Platform API pac admin settings; Work IQ organization IsEnabled Dataverse API settings. Read manage-participation, default-settings and CLI/reference search excerpts; no setting API found.

claims.claim: Tenant Copilot access is managed in Microsoft 365 admin center through Copilot > Settings > View all > Business Applications data in Work IQ available to Copilot.
claims.quote: In the left navigation pane, select Copilot > Settings. ... In Copilot settings, select View all > Business Applications data in Work IQ available to Copilot.

claims.claim: No API for the tenant Business Applications data in Work IQ available to Copilot setting is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Business Applications data Copilot Graph settings; Business Applications Copilot Graph tenant setting API disable. Read default-settings, manage-ai-experience-access and Graph Tenant Configuration Management search excerpts; no matching operation.

claims.claim: Allowed MCP Clients is reached in Power Platform admin center through Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Dataverse Model Context Protocol > Advanced Settings > Allowed MCP Clients.
claims.quote: Go to Manage > Environments ... select Settings. ... Expand Product ... Features. ... In the Dataverse Model Context Protocol section, select Go to Advanced Settings. ... In Advanced Settings > Allowed MCP Clients, open Enterprise Copilot Platform

claims.claim: The linked quickstart walks through enabling an environment end to end.
